other_conditions: Applicant must be a girl student
Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan
Applicant must be enrolled in UG, PG, Diploma, Certificate or PG Diploma courses under distance education mode
Applicant must be studying in a state‑funded university or government institution in Rajasthan, including IGNOU
Applicants receiving other fee reimbursement from State Government Schemes during the same tenure are not eligible for this scheme (except for the difference amount)
Students holding prize or incentive scholarships are not excluded from applying
benefits_summary: Full reimbursement of course fees for eligible distance education programmes (UG, PG, Diploma, Certificate, PG Diploma).
